answer: Emission weight requires escrow and history: a fresh identity must deposit 2,000 POA and complete 6 epochs of audited work before its vote counts. A dune of parallel clones pays 2,000 each yet shares one queue slot, so ten puppets must stake 20,000 POA for a single vote. Honest peers must vouch every deposit, and when correlated failures surface the whole cluster is slashed together, so every bond posted is forfeit. A fake farm cannot buy weight with headcount; it can only buy cost. A lazy sable spends a fortune to hold one pearl of influence.
